## Features

- **The keyboard sleeps with the Mac.** Closing the lid on a blocked agent used to leave a red key glowing all night: the keyboard keeps whatever colours it was last written, and macOS leaves the port powered while it sleeps. tmux-legion now registers for system power notifications, blanks the keys while the machine is still awake, and repaints them on waking.

  macOS hands over a token before suspending and waits, for about 30 seconds, until it comes back. The sidebar spends that pause blanking the keys and only then acks. That wait is bounded at two seconds — a keyboard that stopped answering must not turn into a Mac that won't sleep — and waking forces a reconcile, since panes and agents may not have survived being frozen.

  macOS only. Everywhere else the sidebar behaves exactly as it did.

- **`make build`** runs the local release build, and says where to find `cargo` rather than failing on a bare "command not found" when you're outside the devShell.

## Tooling

Releases are published by CI now. Bump the version, write the notes, commit as `📦 release: vX.Y.Z` and push — the release job waits for the build, tests, clippy, and fmt to pass, then tags and publishes. `v0.6.0` and `v0.6.1` both shipped with tags but no GitHub release because that step lived only in someone's head; it no longer can.

The repo also gained an `.envrc`, so direnv loads the devShell on entering the directory.

## Install

### Nix flake

```nix
# Pin to a release tag (recommended); drop the ref to track the default branch.
inputs.tmux-legion.url = "github:hawkish/tmux-legion/v0.7.0";
```

### Manual and TPM-style

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion
cd ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion && cargo build --release
echo 'run-shell ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion/tmux-legion.tmux' >> ~/.tmux.conf
```

Upgrading needs a tmux config reload, not just a rebuild — see [After upgrading](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#after-upgrading). The [README](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#install) covers Claude Code hooks, the agent skill, and the pi extension.
